  document.querySelectorAll('.tooltip-icon').forEach(icon => {
    const tip = icon.querySelector('.tooltip-content');

    function tooltipAdjustWidth() {
      tip.style.width = 'auto';
      const intrinsic = tip.scrollWidth;
      const maxAllowed = window.innerWidth * 0.9;
      const desired = Math.min(intrinsic * 2, maxAllowed);
      tip.style.width = desired + 'px';
    }

    function tooltipCheckFlip() {
      tip.classList.remove('tooltip-flip');
      const rect = tip.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.top < 0) {
        tip.classList.add('tooltip-flip');
      }
    }

    function tooltipOnShow() {
      tooltipAdjustWidth();
      tooltipCheckFlip();
    }

    icon.addEventListener('mouseenter', tooltipOnShow);

      tip.style.width = desired + 'px';

  document.querySelectorAll('.tooltip-icon').forEach(icon => {
    const tip = icon.querySelector('.tooltip-content');

    function tooltipAdjustWidth() {
      tip.style.width = 'auto';
      const intrinsic = tip.scrollWidth;
      const maxAllowed = window.innerWidth * 0.9;
      const desired = Math.min(intrinsic * 2, maxAllowed);
      tip.style.width = desired + 'px';
    }

    function tooltipCheckFlip() {
      tip.classList.remove('tooltip-flip');
      const rect = tip.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.top < 0) {
        tip.classList.add('tooltip-flip');
      }
    }

    function tooltipOnShow() {
      tooltipAdjustWidth();
      tooltipCheckFlip();
    }

    icon.addEventListener('mouseenter', tooltipOnShow);
